entries.rationale: The Carretera a El Salvador corridor (Santa Catarina Pinula 1108695621, Fraijanes 421185999) functions as part of Guatemala City, and the municipality of Guatemala (421191461) is named bare 'Guatemala', which reads as a country-level label. Coarse cells keep their original owner so remote fallback points stay country-ish. Mixco and Villa Nueva intentionally keep their own names.
